CREATE TABLE "public"."reorderSuggestion" (
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "dismissReason" text,
  "dismissedBy" text,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "lastReportedAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "locationId" text NOT NULL,
  "productId" text NOT NULL,
  "productName" text NOT NULL,
  "purchaseOrderId" text,
  "quantityAvailable" int4 NOT NULL,
  "reorderPoint" int4 NOT NULL,
  "status" text DEFAULT 'OPEN' NOT NULL,
  "suggestedQuantity" int4 NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "reorderSuggestion_status_check_818f8949" CHECK ("status" IN ('OPEN', 'DISMISSED', 'CONVERTED'))
)
